verdict.rationale: Abacum's revenue-planning page says it 'connects pipeline, actuals and capacity in one live model', and it ingests CRM data alongside live actuals, so the core of a CRM-driven revenue plan with actuals is documented. The evidence is high-level marketing copy only: there is no explicit plan-vs-actual variance tracking and no detail on building the plan from pipeline stages or subscription metrics. Missing for 10: documented plan-vs-actual variance tracking, subscription/MRR data ingestion, detailed docs on how pipeline data drives the revenue plan, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can build a revenue plan from CRM pipeline or subscription data and track it against actuals

citations.quote: Abacum connects pipeline, actuals and capacity in one live model.
It connects ERP, CRM, HRIS, spreadsheet, and warehouse data into one governed source of truth
Connect actuals, assumptions, forecasts, and scenarios in one governed workspace
Budgeting and forecasting in one model: top-down targets, bottom-up inputs, live actuals.
